headline: A viral picture of a Texas Tech football fan, seen millions of times, was most likely made with AI and not taken at the game, The Spun reports.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a light example of fake viral images, resting on one outlet's "most likely" finding.
importance_line: What changed: a convincing fake of a sports fan went viral, which affects anyone who shares or trusts pictures during live events; The Spun's finding is stated as "most likely", so it is not proof.
summary: MARCA reports, citing The Spun, that an image of a supposed Texas Tech fan watching the Red Raiders play Houston reportedly drew about 10 million views before being identified as most likely AI-generated rather than taken at the game. MARCA adds that fact-checkers found similar AI-made images of spectators during the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
notes: Read at MARCA (url), which cites The Spun; The Spun article not opened. Game date not stated.
